item: Row 336: a backup checksum read stops at the size the signed list gives
summary: _sha256_file and _digest_matches take the size the volume list gives for the file (listed_bytes); a file larger than that is a mismatch, refused by fstat before any read, and one that grows during the read is cut after at most one byte past the size; the volume-set verify, the parity check, the parity rebuild check and the pool reuse all pass it, so a swapped sparse or endlessly growing volume can no longer keep a verify reading for hours; a list with no usable size reads as before; no acceptance rule changed.
